scenario.opening_question: What matters more for the twins’ birthday: adventure and fresh air or relaxation and beach fun?

options.name: Cozy Mountain Cabin near Pine Lake
options.upside: Quiet setting with lots of nature and outdoor activities
options.tradeoff: Limited dining options and no beach access
options.concern: May feel isolated or boring for kids used to more stimulation
options.best_for: families wanting nature immersion and active days

options.name: Beachfront Condo at Sunny Shores Resort

options.tradeoff: More crowded and less privacy than cabin

options.name: Rustic Cabin with Mountain Views and Fireplace

attrs.activities: campfire storytelling, short hikes, wildlife spotting

options.tradeoff: Fewer modern amenities and no nearby stores
options.concern: Could feel too remote or uncomfortable for some
options.best_for: families valuing ambiance and quiet relaxation

options.name: Family Suite at Oceanview Beach Hotel
options.upside: Hotel services and organized kids’ activities included
options.tradeoff: Less privacy and potential for crowded public spaces
options.concern: May feel less like a getaway and more commercial
options.best_for: families wanting convenience and structured entertainment
